hints.title: Suffix Uniqueness
hints.text: Notice that elements removed from the front leave a valid suffix that must contain unique items.

hints.title: Reverse Traversal
hints.text: Traverse the array from right to left tracking seen values in a set.

hints.title: Operation Calculation
hints.text: Upon encountering the first duplicate at index i from the right, return floor(i / 3) + 1.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass from right to left with set lookups.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating repeated front deletions takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) set tracks seen elements in the suffix.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that preserving the longest distinct suffix dictates operations in linear time.
